{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 180.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0     # s for any one solve
PROBE_POOL = 500.0        # s granted for the probe
PROBE_SPENT = 9.9      # s the probe actually used

results = evaluate_target_errors(airplane, dry_mass_properties, auw_mass_properties)
worst_error = results["worst_error"]
wl_record = [r for r in results["records"] if r["name"] == "Wing loading"][0]
wl_ratio = wl_record["rel_tol"]
span_record = [r for r in results["records"] if r["name"] == "Wing span"][0]
span_error = span_record["error_pct"]
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{worst_error:.2f}%"`]{.hero-value}
[worst error across eight published targets]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** Yes. Reconstructing the airframe from the plan sheet and published specifications reproduces all eight target metrics within tolerance. The worst discrepancy is [`{python} f"{worst_error:.2f}%"`]{.key} on wing loading, utilizing [`{python} f"{wl_ratio:.1f}%"`]{.key} of its allowable margin. Wingspan lands within [`{python} f"{span_error:.2f}%"`]{.key} and length matches exactly (@fig-three-view, @fig-target-errors).
